number: The bench stage measures what the build needs before any reading: Stage A's clearances (the beamsplitter at %pin:p2_tg_psi_dm96_oap_aoi% degrees, pinned by Dave's 2026-09-15 ruling; the compensator, the tightest node part, clears by %pin:p2_tg_psi_dm96_oap_comp% mm, under the 25 mm spec, as the report says), the sampling budget (a detector Nyquist margin of %pin:p2_tg_psi_dm96_oap_nyq%x against the DM's), and the stations check: the polarization four-step recovers the engine's own field on a 30 nm working surface with gain %pin:p2_tg_psi_dm96_oap_gain% (%pin:p2_tg_psi_dm96_oap_resid% pm residual), the PZT four-step exactly. The run committed in `runs/lens/` (2026-09-12) predates the pin and shows the Stage-A solve's 7 degrees.
